description:
GetCommandResponse is the structured output emitted by the "get" command
 when running in JSON output mode.

items.description: GetCommandResponseBridge describes a single bridge in the get command output.

application_status.description:
Status of the developer's local application as reported by the
 interceptor's probe monitors. One of:
   - "stopped"      — no devcontainer is running for this bridge
   - "unreachable"  — devcontainer is up but the interceptor isn't responding
   - "starting"     — interceptor is still initializing, or probes are pending
   - "no probes"    — source deployment didn't declare liveness/readiness/startup
   - "healthy"      — every configured probe reports healthy
   - "unhealthy"    — at least one configured probe reports unhealthy

deployment_name.description: The name of the bridge Deployment.

namespace.description: The namespace where the bridge is running.

source_deployment.description: The source deployment this bridge was cloned from.

source_namespace.description: The source namespace of the deployment.

status.description: Current status of the bridge in the cluster (e.g. "running", "pending").
